bookkeeping_convention: Interpret the reported total_enthalpy field as the complete enthalpy correction Hcorrto the electronic energy,including zero-point energy. The published working identity isG=Eelectronic+Hcorr-T*S. Infer Tfrom the actual reported quantities;do not assume it in advance. A proposed alternative adds ZPEagain. All energies are reported ineVand entropy ineV/K.
context_policy: Within one solvent row,E,Hcorr,S,Gand ZPEmust retain the same molecular identity,level_of_theoryand thermo property_id. Across solvent rows,compare a free-energy difference only when the displayed electronic-structure/solvation level matches;different solvent calculations naturally have different property_ids. Do not identify an absent solvent label or mix values from different row keys.
difference: Return G(custom_A)-G(custom_B)as the explicitly method-matched computed row difference. Do not call any vacuum-to-solution subtraction an experimentally calibrated solvation free energy or standard-state correction.
